headline: SR Inc Net Zero Consortium for Buyers: Seven-Buyer Aggregation for 180 MW of Millers Branch Solar Now Online
summary: The 180 MW Phase II portion of the Millers Branch Solar Facility in Haskell County, Texas has achieved commercial operation. The capacity was contracted through Sustainability Roundtable, Inc's Net Zero Consortium for Buyers (NZCB) by Cisco, Juniper Networks (now part of Hewlett Packard Enterprise), Bio-Rad Laboratories, Cadence Design Systems, IDEXX Laboratories, Inc., PTC, and a large healthcare company, which signed an aggregated virtual power purchase agreement (VPPA) with Southern Power Com
